name: Abbey of Kings Fast Castle → White Tower Timing by Swaggy Professor
author: Swaggy Professor

notes: Send **all villagers** to @resource/sheep.webp@.
Use @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to circle base and find more sheep.
First **3 new villagers** build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and a @building_economy/house.webp@ near TC.
Next **3 villagers → @resource/sheep.webp@** (final 9 food / 3 gold).
When resources allow, age up with @landmark_templar/abbey-of-kings.webp@ using the **3 gold villagers**.
Send **2 food villagers → @resource/resource_stone.webp@** and **4 → straggler trees**.
Set TC @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 4 villagers there, then back to sheep.
After mining 100@resource/resource_stone.webp@, send both stone vils → @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Once 175@resource/resource_wood.webp@ gathered, send the 4 straggler wood vils → @resource/sheep.webp@.
After Feudal age-up: use 4 gold villagers to build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ to influence @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/sheep.webp@ (include @resource/resource_wood.webp@ if close).
Scout opponent’s base — if they’re passive, send @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ to harass exposed vils.
If facing early aggression, you can:
- Place Manor beside @resource/resource_wood.webp@ instead for Feudal defense.
- Transition into military production buildings around it.
- Defend with Lords or tower gold if needed.
Continue normal build if safe: maintain **7 gold / 2 wood / rest on food**.
At ~6:20, start @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ with **8 food villagers** (send more if pressured).
Place landmark near @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or between gold + woodline.
While landmark builds, set TC @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for remainder of game.
Use 2–3 gold villagers to build 2@building_military/stable.webp@ nearby.
Train 1 extra @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ from @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@.
After aging up, eco layout: 10 food / 12 gold / 1 stone / rest wood.
Start constant @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ production from stables.
If pressured: use spawned Men-at-Arms + Lords defensively.
Otherwise, pressure with Knights + Lords to gain map control and relics.
Add @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ + @building_religious/monastery.webp@ for relics and upgrades.
Optional tech path: add @building_military/archery-range.webp@ if enemy makes spears/crossbows.
If sheep run out → move to @resource/berrybush.webp@ or external food.
Your 1 stone villager will have enough for another @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ → place near new food source to maintain influence on ≥10 vils.
Always aim for 10+ vils under each manor for best passive bonus.
Keep producing units, complete eco upgrades, and build @building_economy/farm.webp@ clusters around manors.
At this stage, your eco should be extremely strong with relics + manor passive income.
You can close games with Knight/Lord pushes or safely go Imperial depending on map control.

description: Flexible Abbey of Kings Fast Castle into White Tower with adaptive Feudal defense. Early stone for Manor influence, optional pressure with Lords, and strong eco transition with Manors and Relics.
strategy: Abbey of Kings Fast Castle → White Tower Knight Pressure
